pages.title: Overview
pages.content:
UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge — LUMPI Track

Muhammad Shahbaz  ·  Shaurya Agarwal

A challenge track of the 6th DriveX Workshop @ ECCV 2026 — drivex-workshop.github.io/eccv2026.

Roadside LiDAR perception for intelligent transportation systems is bottlenecked by the cost and rarity of large, well-annotated real datasets. This challenge asks: can synthetic LiDAR data be made realistic enough that a deep learning model trained on it generalizes to real LiDAR frames?

Towards that, this challenge asks participants to generate their own synthetic LiDAR data targeting the LUMPI distribution, train an object detector on that data, and submit detections on real held-out frames. We score on (1) how distributionally close their synthetic frames are to real ones, and (2) how well the sim-only detector performs on real frames.

Reference resources for participants

To support participants who would like a documented starting point, we make publicly available a complete reference pipeline covering synthesis methodology, empirical analysis, ready-to-use synthetic datasets, and an open-source LiDAR data processing and visualization software. These materials are offered as orientation, not as requirements.

The synthesis pipeline is described in UrbanTwin: Building High-Fidelity Digital Twins for Sim2Real LiDAR Perception and Evaluation (arXiv preprint), with a deeper empirical analysis including the distributional realism metrics adopted by this challenge in High-Fidelity Digital Twins for Bridging the Sim2Real Gap in LiDAR-Based ITS Perception (IEEE T-ITS, 2026).

The synthetic LiDAR datasets generated with that pipeline are released in UrbanTwin: Synthetic Roadside LiDAR Datasets (IEEE OJ-ITS, 2026) and are available for download at Harvard Dataverse. Each dataset contains 10K frames annotated across six object categories for detection, tracking, and segmentation tasks, and is directly compatible with the multi-class evaluation used here; empirical analysis in papers include both the distributional realism metrics and single-class 3D object detection study as proof-of-concept. For end-to-end LiDAR processing we also provide our LiGuard Framework (IEEE T-IV, 2026) with short, more software focused read on The Journal of Open Source Software.

What you will do

  1. Download the public real LUMPI dataset and the released detection-test point clouds (50 real frames, no labels).
  2. Generate synthetic LiDAR frames using any approach you like — simulation (CARLA, LGSVL, custom), generative models (diffusion, GANs, flow-based), hybrid pipelines, or anything else.
  3. Train a 3D object detector (any architecture) on only your synthetic data.
  4. Submit:
    • 50 of your synthetic LiDAR frames,
    • your detector's predictions on the 50 released test point clouds,
    • and a signed honor declaration.

Scoring at a glance

Combined score = 0.6 × normalized 3D mAP + 0.4 × normalized realism, where 3D mAP is averaged across the 8 object categories defined for this track (Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown) and realism averages normalized Chamfer Distance, MMD, EMD, and Fréchet Point-cloud Distance. See the Evaluation tab for the formulae.

Prizes

Per track:

  • 1st place: USD 500
  • 2nd place: USD 300
  • 3rd place: USD 200

Sponsor(s) will be announced before the Development phase opens.

Phases

  • Development — public leaderboard, up to 5 submissions/day per participant, 100 total. Use this to iterate.
  • Final — private leaderboard until close, 5 total submissions per participant. The final-phase ranking determines the winners.

Baselines

Reference numbers are listed in the Data tab.
pages.content_zh:
# UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR 挑战赛 — LUMPI 赛道

*第6届DriveX工作坊 @ ECCV 2026 的挑战赛道 — [drivex-workshop.github.io/eccv2026](https://drivex-workshop.github.io/eccv2026)*

路边LiDAR感知在智能交通系统中的发展受到大规模、标注完善的真实数据集成本高且稀缺的制约。本挑战赛提出：能否使合成LiDAR数据达到足够的真实性，使得在其上训练的深度学习模型能够泛化到真实LiDAR帧？

为此，本挑战赛要求参与者针对**LUMPI**分布生成自己的合成LiDAR数据、在该数据上训练目标检测器，并在真实的保留测试帧上提交检测结果。评分基于：(1) 其合成帧与真实帧的分布接近程度，以及 (2) 仅在合成数据上训练的检测器在真实帧上的性能。

## 参与者参考资源

为支持寻求文档化起点的参与者，我们公开提供了一套完整的参考管道，涵盖合成方法、经验分析、即用型合成数据集和开源LiDAR数据处理与可视化软件。这些资料作为参考方向提供，而非强制要求。

合成管道在《[UrbanTwin: 为Sim2Real LiDAR感知与评估构建高保真数字孪生体](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.02903)》(arXiv预印本)中描述，更深入的经验分析包括本挑战赛所采用的分布真实性指标，详见《[高保真数字孪生体缩小LiDAR基础智能交通感知中的Sim2Real差距](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?oi=bibs&cluster=6844982498826808010&btnI=1&hl=en)》(IEEE T-ITS, 2026)。

使用该管道生成的合成LiDAR数据集发布在《[UrbanTwin: 合成路边LiDAR数据集](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/iel8/8784355/8957420/11357520.pdf)》(IEEE OJ-ITS, 2026)中，可从[哈佛数据库](https://dataverse.harvard.edu/dataverse/ucf-ut)下载。每个数据集包含**10K帧**，跨越**6个目标类别**，用于**检测、跟踪和分割任务**，与本挑战赛使用的多类评估完全兼容；论文中的经验分析既包括分布真实性指标，也包括单类3D目标检测研究作为概念验证。对于端到端LiDAR处理，我们还提供了[LiGuard框架](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11498694)(IEEE T-IV, 2026)以及更加软件聚焦的简明读物《[开源软件期刊](https://joss.theoj.org/papers/10.21105/joss.06751.pdf)》。

## 你将执行的步骤

1. 下载公开真实**LUMPI**数据集和发布的检测测试点云(50个真实帧，无标签)。
2. 使用任何方法生成合成LiDAR帧 — 模拟(CARLA、LGSVL、自定义)、生成模型(扩散、GANs、流基模型)、混合管道或其他任何方法。
3. 在**仅你的合成数据**上训练3D目标检测器(任何架构)。
4. 提交：
   - 50个你的合成LiDAR帧
   - 你的检测器在50个发布测试点云上的预测结果
   - 一份签署的诚信声明

## 评分概览

综合评分 = `0.6 × 归一化3D mAP` + `0.4 × 归一化真实性`，其中3D mAP在本赛道定义的**8个**目标类别(*行人、汽车、自行车、摩托车、公交车、卡车、货车、未知*)上平均，真实性平均归一化的Chamfer距离、MMD、EMD和Fr

pages.title: Evaluation
pages.content:
Evaluation Protocol

Two scores are computed and combined into a single Combined score that determines leaderboard rank.

1. Distributional realism

Aggregation:

  1. Concatenate the 50 submitted synthetic frames into one set S_syn; concatenate the 50 held-out real reference frames into S_real.
  2. Mask both to the point-cloud range [-40, -40, -5, 40, 40, 5].
  3. Subsample uniformly at random to N = 10,000 points per side, with seed 1234 (identical seed used by the local evaluator in the starter kit).
  4. Compute one CD, MMD, EMD, and FPD across the entire 10,000-point sets.

1a. Chamfer Distance (CD)

CD(P, Q) = (1/|P|) Σ_{p ∈ P} min_{q ∈ Q} ||p - q||²
         + (1/|Q|) Σ_{q ∈ Q} min_{p ∈ P} ||p - q||²

Squared-L2 nearest-neighbor cost; symmetric. Lower is better.

1b. Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD)

MMD²(X, Y) = E[k(x, x')] + E[k(y, y')] - 2 E[k(x, y)],   k(a, b) = exp(-γ ||a - b||²)

Unbiased estimator (off-diagonal). Bandwidth γ is set by the median heuristic on a 1 000-point joint subsample (γ = 1 / (2 · median ||x - y||²)) so the kernel does not saturate at LiDAR spatial scales. Lower is better.

1c. Earth Mover's Distance (EMD)

EMD(X, Y) = √ ( min_{T ∈ Π(X, Y)} Σ_{i,j} T_{ij} · ||x_i - y_j|| )

Wasserstein-1 with Euclidean ground cost, solved exactly by the network simplex (POT's ot.emd2). Reported in metres. Lower is better.

1d. Fréchet Point-cloud Distance (FPD)

FPD = ||μ_X - μ_Y||² + Tr(Σ_X + Σ_Y - 2 (Σ_X · Σ_Y)^{1/2})

FID-style: fits a 3-variate Gaussian to each set's points, computes the 2-Wasserstein between Gaussians. Lower is better.

2. 3D Object Detection

Participants submit detections (predictions.json) on 50 real LiDAR frames whose ground truth is held out. We compute average precision over the 8 object categories defined for this track (Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown), at IoU thresholds 0.5 (primary) and 0.7 (secondary). Per-class AP is reported, and mean AP across classes (mAP) is the leaderboard's detection score; classes with zero ground-truth instances in the held-out set are excluded from the mean. Both KITTI 11-point and 40-point interpolated AP are reported; the 40-point form is the leaderboard primary.

Ground-truth and predicted boxes use the OpenPCDet 7-DoF format [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading]. IoU is computed as 3D intersection-over-union between two oriented BEV rectangles times the Z overlap. The KITTI truncation/occlusion/min-height difficulty filter is not applied because those depend on 2D bounding-box annotations that are not natural for roadside LiDAR datasets.

The valid class strings for this track are listed in config.json (shipped in reference_data/) and in submission_format.md in the starter kit. Any prediction with an unrecognized class label is discarded.

3. Combined score

Each component is min-max normalized into [0, 1] using a per-track normalization range:

score_realism   = mean( norm(CD), norm(MMD), norm(EMD), norm(FPD) )    (lower-is-better → 1 - clip)
score_detection = norm( AP_3d @ IoU 0.5 )                               (higher-is-better → clip)
score_combined  = 0.6 · score_detection + 0.4 · score_realism

Normalization endpoints are public in config.json (shipped in reference_data/), so the local evaluator and the server compute identical scores.

Reproducibility

  • Realism is dataset-level — frame ordering does not matter. Submit the 50 synthetic frames in any consistent naming.
  • Subsampling RNG seed: 1234 (same on server and starting kit).
  • The exact scoring program shipped to the Codabench worker is included in the starting kit.
pages.content_zh:
# 评估协议

计算两个分数并将其合并为单一的综合分数 以确定排行榜排名。

1. 分布真实性

聚合：

  1. 将50个提交的合成帧连接成一个集合 S_syn；将50个保留的真实参考帧 连接成S_real。
  2. 将两者都掩盖到点云范围 [-40, -40, -5, 40, 40, 5]。
  3. 以种子1234均匀随机子采样到每侧N = 10,000个点 （启动工具包中的本地评估器使用相同种子）。
  4. 在整个10,000点集上计算一个CD、MMD、EMD和FPD。

1a. 倒角距离（CD）

CD(P, Q) = (1/|P|) Σ_{p ∈ P} min_{q ∈ Q} ||p - q||²
         + (1/|Q|) Σ_{q ∈ Q} min_{p ∈ P} ||p - q||²

平方L2最近邻成本；对称的。数值越小越好。

1b. 最大均值差异（MMD）

MMD²(X, Y) = E[k(x, x')] + E[k(y, y')] - 2 E[k(x, y)],   k(a, b) = exp(-γ ||a - b||²)

无偏估计量（非对角线）。带宽γ通过1000点联合子样本上的中值启发式设置 （γ = 1 / (2 · median ||x - y||²)），以便核在LiDAR空间尺度上不饱和。数值越小越好。

1c. 地球移动距离（EMD）

EMD(X, Y) = √ ( min_{T ∈ Π(X, Y)} Σ_{i,j} T_{ij} · ||x_i - y_j|| )

Wasserstein-1距离，欧几里得地面成本，通过网络单纯形精确求解（POT的ot.emd2）。以米为单位报告。数值越小越好。

1d. 弗雷歇点云距离（FPD）

FPD = ||μ_X - μ_Y||² + Tr(Σ_X + Σ_Y - 2 (Σ_X · Σ_Y)^{1/2})

FID风格：对每个集合的点拟合3变量高斯分布，计算高斯分布之间的2-Wasserstein距离。数值越小越好。

2. 3D物体检测

参与者在50个真实LiDAR帧上提交检测结果（predictions.json），这些帧的真实标注被保留。我们在为该赛道定义的8个物体类别上计算平均精度 （行人、汽车、自行车、摩托车、公交车、卡车、货车、未知），IoU阈值为0.5（主要）和0.7 （次要）。报告每个类别的AP，以及各类别的平均AP （mAP）是排行榜检测分数；保留集中零个真实标注实例的类别被排除在平均值之外。报告KITTI 11点和40点插值AP；40点形式是排行榜主要指标。

真实标注框和预测框使用OpenPCDet 7自由度格式 [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading]。IoU计算为两个有向BEV矩形之间的3D交并比乘以Z重叠。未应用KITTI截断/遮挡/最小高度难度过滤器，因为这些取决于对于路边LiDAR数据集不太自然的2D边界框注释。

该赛道的有效类别字符串在 config.json中列出（在reference_data/中提供）以及 启动工具包中的submission_format.md。任何带有无法识别的类别标签的预测都被丢弃。

3. 综合分数

使用每条赛道的归一化范围将每个分量最大-最小归一化为[0, 1]：

score_realism   = mean( norm(CD), norm(MMD), norm(EMD), norm(FPD) )    (数值越小越好 → 1 - clip)
score_detection = norm( AP_3d @ IoU 0.5 )                               (数值越大越好 → clip)
score_combined  = 0.6 · score_detection + 0.4 · score_realism

归一化端点在config.json中公开（在reference_data/中提供），因此本地评估器和服务器

pages.title: Data
pages.content:
Data

LUMPI

Real LUMPI data is publicly available from its original release. We do not redistribute it. Participants must obtain the real dataset directly from its source under its own license.

  • Source: https://data.uni-hannover.de/dataset/lumpi
  • License: see the source.

Released for participants

The starting kit (Files tab → starting_kit) contains:

  • detection_test_frames/ — 50 real LiDAR frames (point clouds only, no labels) on which you must run your detector and submit predictions.
  • detection_test_frame_ids.json — the canonical list of frame IDs your predictions.json must cover, in order.
  • forbidden_frames.txt — 100 frame IDs you may not train, validate, or hyperparameter-tune on. This is the union of the 50 detection-test frames and the 50 realism-reference frames. Honor system, enforced by signed declaration in your submission.
  • local_eval.py — the exact scoring program shipped to the Codabench worker. Run it locally to reproduce server scores bit-for-bit, given a dummy reference set you generate from the released detection-test frames.
  • make_dummy_submission.py — produces a known-bad submission that exercises the format. Useful for sanity-checking your pipeline.
  • submission_format.md — full submission spec.

Held out (organizer-only)

  • 50 real frames used as the realism reference set.
  • Ground-truth boxes for the 50 detection-test frames.

Categories evaluated

This track is scored on 8 object categories defined for the LUMPI dataset: Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown. The leaderboard's detection score is the mean AP across these categories; classes with zero ground-truth instances in the held-out 50-frame set are excluded from the mean.

Splits

Splits are stratified random samples with fixed seed 1234. The exact frame ID lists are published in the starting kit so anyone can reproduce them from the released real dataset.

Reference baselines

The numbers below are reported for the Car class only, taken from prior work on this dataset. The leaderboard's detection score is the mean AP across all categories defined for this track (see Evaluation), so submissions are scored on broader coverage than these single-class references. The baselines are included to demonstrate that sim → real transfer is achievable on this benchmark and to provide a per-class reference point for orientation while you iterate.

SystemCar 3D AP @ 0.5Car 3D AP @ 0.7
SEED (real LUMPI training, IEEE T-ITS 2026) 0.4270 n/r
SEED (UT-LUMPI synthetic → real LUMPI, IEEE T-ITS 2026) 0.4474 n/r
pages.content_zh:
数据

LUMPI

真实的 LUMPI 数据可从其原始发布源公开获取。我们不重新分发这些数据。参赛者必须根据其许可证直接从源获取真实数据集。

  • 来源： https://data.uni-hannover.de/dataset/lumpi
  • 许可证： 见源站点。

为参赛者发布的内容

起始工具包（Files 选项卡 → starting_kit）包含：

  • detection_test_frames/ —— 50个真实激光雷达帧（仅点云，无标注），你必须在其上运行检测器并提交预测结果。
  • detection_test_frame_ids.json —— 你的 predictions.json 必须覆盖的规范帧ID列表，按顺序排列。
  • forbidden_frames.txt —— 100个帧ID，你不得用于训练、验证或超参数调优。这是50个检测测试帧和50个真实性参考帧的并集。采用荣誉制，通过提交中的签署声明来执行。
  • local_eval.py —— 部署到Codabench worker的确切评分程序。在本地运行以重现服务器评分结果（精确到位），需要从发布的检测测试帧生成虚拟参考集。
  • make_dummy_submission.py —— 生成已知不良提交以测试格式。用于完整性检查你的处理流程。
  • submission_format.md —— 完整提交规范。

保留数据（仅组织者可见）

  • 50个真实帧用作真实性参考集。
  • 50个检测测试帧的真实标注框。

评估类别

该赛道对LUMPI数据集定义的8个对象类别进行评分： 行人、汽车、自行车、摩托车、公交车、卡车、货车、未知。排行榜的检测评分是这些类别的平均AP；在保留的50帧集中没有真实实例的类别从平均值中排除。

数据划分

划分为使用固定种子1234的分层随机样本。确切的帧ID列表已在起始工具包中发布，任何人都可以从发布的真实数据集中重现它们。

参考基线

下面的数字仅针对汽车类别报告，取自该数据集的先前研究。排行榜的检测评分是该赛道定义的所有类别的平均AP（见评估），因此提交内容按比这些单类参考更广泛的范围进行评分。包含这些基线是为了证明模拟→真实迁移在此基准上是可行的，并在你迭代时提供单类参考点以供参考。

系统汽车3D AP @ 0.5汽车3D AP @ 0.7
SEED（真实LUMPI训练，IEEE T-ITS 2026） 0.4270 未报告
SEED（UT-LUMPI合成→真实LUMPI，IEEE T-ITS 2026） 0.4474 未报告

pages.title: Submission
pages.content:
Submission Format

Pack everything below into a single submission.zip and upload it on the Submit tab.

submission.zip
├── synthetic/
│   ├── 0001.bin
│   ├── 0002.bin
│   ├── ...
│   └── 0050.bin           # exactly 50 files
├── predictions.json
└── declaration.pdf        # signed honor declaration (PDF). declaration.txt also accepted.

synthetic/<id>.bin

  • Exactly 50 files.
  • Each file is raw float32, shape N × 3, in row-major order, with channels (x, y, z) in metres.
  • Either N × 3 or N × 4 (xyz + intensity) is accepted; the intensity column, if present, is dropped before scoring.
  • Each file ≤ 1.5 MB on disk (~125,000 points). Realism is computed at the dataset level: all 50 frames are concatenated, masked to the track's point-cloud range, then subsampled to 10,000 points (seed 1234) before computing CD / MMD / EMD / FPD. Submitting denser frames does not improve scores; frame ordering does not matter.
  • The simplest valid naming is 0001.bin … 0050.bin.

predictions.json

JSON object whose keys are the frame IDs from detection_test_frame_ids.json (in the starting kit). For every frame ID you must include an entry, even if the value is an empty list.

{
  "<frame_id_1>": [
    {"box": [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading], "score": 0.97, "class": "Car"},
    {"box": [...],                          "score": 0.81, "class": "Person"}
  ],
  "<frame_id_2>": [],
  ...
}
  • box: 7 floats, OpenPCDet convention. (x, y, z) is the box center in metres in the LiDAR frame, (dx, dy, dz) are full extents along the box-local axes, heading is rotation around +Z in radians.
  • score: confidence in [0, 1].
  • class: one of the valid class strings for this track. Valid values: Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown. Class strings are matched case-insensitively. Predictions with unrecognized class strings are discarded before AP is computed.

declaration.pdf (or declaration.txt)

The starter kit ships declaration_template.pdf, a one-page form with the required honor statement preprinted and a signature line. Fill in team name and date, sign (digitally with any PDF tool, or print → sign → scan), save as declaration.pdf, and include it in every submission.

If you cannot easily produce a signed PDF, a plain declaration.txt is also accepted. Required statement (verbatim, case-insensitive):

I confirm that I did not train on any frame listed in forbidden_frames.txt, and that all submitted detections were produced by a model trained only on synthetic data I generated.

What gets returned

After scoring (typically < 5 minutes for valid submissions) you'll see your position on the leaderboard plus a Detailed Results view with all component metrics, including per-class AP.
pages.content_zh:
提交格式

将以下所有内容打包到单个 submission.zip 文件中，并在提交标签页上传。

submission.zip
├── synthetic/
│   ├── 0001.bin
│   ├── 0002.bin
│   ├── ...
│   └── 0050.bin           # 恰好 50 个文件
├── predictions.json
└── declaration.pdf        # 已签署的诚信声明（PDF）。也接受 declaration.txt。

synthetic/<id>.bin

  • 恰好50个文件。
  • 每个文件为原始 float32 格式，形状 N × 3，按行主序排列，通道为 (x, y, z)（单位：米）。
  • 接受 N × 3 或 N × 4（xyz + 强度）格式；如果存在强度列，在评分前将被删除。
  • 每个文件 ≤ 1.5 MB（约 125,000 个点）。真实性在数据集级别计算：将所有 50 帧连接、掩膜至轨迹的点云范围，然后子采样至 10,000 个点（种子 1234），之后计算 CD / MMD / EMD / FPD。提交更密集的帧不会改善分数；帧顺序不重要。
  • 最简单的有效命名方式是 0001.bin … 0050.bin。

predictions.json

JSON 对象，其键为来自 detection_test_frame_ids.json（在起始工具包中）的帧 ID。对于每个帧 ID，必须包含一个条目，即使值为空列表也是如此。

{
  "<frame_id_1>": [
    {"box": [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading], "score": 0.97, "class": "Car"},
    {"box": [...],                          "score": 0.81, "class": "Person"}
  ],
  "<frame_id_2>": [],
  ...
}
  • box：7 个浮点数，OpenPCDet 约定。(x, y, z) 是 LiDAR 框架中的框中心（单位：米），(dx, dy, dz) 是沿框局部轴的完整范围，heading 是围绕 +Z 轴的旋转角度（单位：弧度）。
  • score：置信度，范围 [0, 1]。
  • class：该轨迹的有效类别字符串之一。有效值为：Person、Car、Bicycle、Motorcycle、Bus、Truck、Van、Unknown。类别字符串匹配不区分大小写。具有无法识别的类别字符串的预测在计算 AP 前将被丢弃。

declaration.pdf（或 declaration.txt）

起始工具包附带 declaration_template.pdf，一份单页表单，具有预印的必需诚信声明和签名行。填写团队名称和日期，签名（用任何 PDF 工具进行数字签名，或打印 → 签名 → 扫描），另存为 declaration.pdf，并将其包含在每次提交中。

如果无法轻松生成已签署的 PDF，也接受纯文本 declaration.txt。必需声明（逐字，不区分大小写）：

I confirm that I did not train on any frame listed in forbidden_frames.txt, and that all submitted detections were produced by a model trained only on synthetic data I generated.

返回结果

评分后（通常对于有效提交耗时 < 5 分钟），您将在排行榜上看到您的排名，以及详细结果视图，其中包含所有组件指标，包括按类别的 AP。

pages.title: Rules
pages.content:
Rules

Eligibility

  • Open to anyone — researchers, students, industry teams.
  • Each team must register one participant account; do not maintain multiple accounts.

Allowed

  • Any simulation framework or generative model (CARLA, Helios++, OpenScene, neural radiance fields, diffusion, GANs, custom physics). Open or closed source — what matters is the synthesized data.
  • Any 3D object detector architecture, trained on your synthetic data only.
  • Augmentations applied during detector training (rotation, scale, flip, ground-truth sampling, noise) — they operate on synthetic data, not on the forbidden real frames.
  • Using the train split of the public real dataset for hyperparameter selection or domain adaptation, provided no forbidden frame is touched. (The forbidden list contains only the 100 reserved frames, not the entire real train split.)

Forbidden

  • Training, validating, hyperparameter-tuning, or otherwise observing ground truth from any of the 100 frames listed in forbidden_frames.txt. This is enforced by signed declaration and is the foundational integrity rule of the challenge.
  • Submitting predictions produced by a model that has been trained on real labels for any roadside-LiDAR dataset. The detector must be sim-only.
  • Reverse-engineering or inferring the held-out realism reference frames via Codabench's leaderboard signal (e.g., probing submissions designed to leak the reference set's identity). Submissions found to be doing this will be disqualified.
  • Multiple accounts, sub-team accounts, or coordinating across registered teams.

Disqualification

Organizers reserve the right to inspect the synthetic frames and predictions of any submission for evidence of forbidden-frame leakage (e.g., synthetic frames that suspiciously resemble held-out real frames; predictions whose distribution implies access to held-out ground truth). Disqualified participants are removed from the leaderboard and from prize consideration.

Prizes

Per track: 1st place USD 500, 2nd place USD 300, 3rd place USD 200. Sponsor(s) will be announced before the Development phase opens.

Publication and credit

  • Every participating team submits a 4–8 page challenge report describing their approach.
  • Teams that prefer not to publish may opt into the workshop's non-publication track for their submission.
  • Top-3 teams per track are additionally invited to submit a full paper to the proceedings track of the next edition of the DriveX Workshop.
  • The challenge organizers may publish an aggregate analysis of all submissions (anonymized unless explicit permission is granted).

# 规则

## 参赛资格
- 面向所有人开放——研究人员、学生、行业团队。
- 每支团队必须注册一个参赛者账户；不得维护多个账户。

## 允许的做法
- 任何仿真框架或生成模型（CARLA、Helios++、OpenScene、神经辐射场、扩散模型、GAN、自定义物理引擎）。开源或闭源都可以——重要的是合成数据。
- 任何3D目标检测器架构，仅在**你的合成数据上**训练。
- 检测器训练期间应用的数据增强（旋转、缩放、翻转、真值采样、噪声）——它们作用于合成数据，不作用于禁用的真实帧。
- 使用公开真实数据集的**训练集分割**进行超参数选择或域适应，**前提是不涉及禁用帧**。（禁用列表仅包含100个预留帧，不包含整个真实训练集分割。）

## 禁止的做法
- 对`forbidden_frames.txt`中列出的**任何**100个帧进行训练、验证、超参数调优或以其他方式观察真值。这由签署声明强制执行，是该竞赛的基础诚信规则。
- 提交由在**任何**路边LiDAR数据集的真实标签上训练过的模型产生的预测。检测器必须仅限于仿真。
- 通过Codabench排行榜信号逆向工程或推断保留的真实参考帧（例如，提交设计用于泄露参考集身份的预测）。发现进行此操作的提交将被取消资格。
- 多个账户、子团队账户或注册团队间的协调。

## 取消资格
组织者保留权利检查任何提交的合成帧和预测，以确认是否存在禁用帧泄露的证据（例如，与保留真实帧异常相似的合成帧；其分布表明可以访问保留真值的预测）。被取消资格的参赛者将从排行榜和奖金考虑中移除。

## 奖项
每个赛道：第1名USD 500、第2名USD 300、第3名USD 200。赞助商将在开发阶段开始前公布。

## 发布和署名
- 每支参赛团队提交一份**4–8页竞赛报告**，描述其方法。
- 倾向于不发布的团队可选择加入车间的**非发布赛道**进行提交。
- 每个赛道排名前3的团队另外被邀请提交完整论文至**下一届DriveX车间论文集赛道**。
- 竞赛组织者可发布所有提交的汇总分析（匿名处理，除非获得明确许可）。

17595.title: ChildSafeAds: Commercial Content in Child-Facing YouTube Videos (NLLP @ EMNLP 2026)
17595.description: Detect and classify commercial content in YouTube videos that plausibly reach a minor audience: commercial type, product category, and compliance risk flags grounded in EU consumer law. Framed as a system-design challenge over four data-access levels.
17595.description_zh:
# YouTube商业内容检测与分类系统：未成年人受众合规评估

## 系统概述
针对可能触及未成年人受众的YouTube视频中的商业内容进行检测、分类和合规风险评估，基于欧盟消费者法律框架，分四个数据访问层级架构。

---

## 第一层：基础内容识别

### 检测维度
- **视频元数据分析**：频道类目、观众年龄统计、内容标签
- **视频脚本扫描**：自动字幕/手动转录的商业语言模式识别
- **视觉元素识别**：品牌logo、产品展示、赞助标识

### 输出分类
| 商业内容类型 | 识别信号 | 风险等级 |
|---------|--------|--------|
| 直接广告 | 明确产品推荐、定价信息 | 高 |
| 原生广告 | 产品集成、品牌合作 | 中高 |
| 隐性置入 | 背景品牌、角色使用产品 | 中 |
| 联盟营销 | 推荐链接、折扣码 | 中高 |

---

## 第二层：产品类别与监管映射

### 高风险产品类别（未成年人保护）
- **食品饮料**：高糖/高盐、能量饮料、酒精相关
- **科技产品**：游戏、社交应用、沉浸式内容
- **时尚美容**：化妆品、整容相关服务、极端减肥产品
- **金融产品**：加密资产、赌博、在线交易平台
- **药品与补充剂**：处方药推荐、声称疗效的补充品

### 分类规则
```
产品类别 → 年龄敏感度 → 欧盟指令 → 特定标记要求
```

**示例**：能量饮料(食品) → 高(12岁以下) → 2006/114/EC(误导性广告) → 必须标注"咖啡因含量"

---

## 第三层：欧盟合规风险标记

### 法律框架应用

#### A. 欧盟《消费者权利指令》(2011/83/EU)
- **风险标记**：
  - 缺少清晰的商业意图披露
  - 不透明的价格条款
  - 无冷静期声明（适用产品）

#### B. 《不公平商业惯例指令》(2005/29/EC)
- **风险标记**：
  - 虚假/误导性声明（健康效益、性能）
  - 攻击性营销实践（强制购买、时间压力）
  - 儿童针对性的操纵策略

#### C. 《视听传媒服务指令》(2010/13/EU)修订案
- **风险标记**：
  - 缺少商业广告边界标记("reklame"、"Werbung"、"publicité")
  - 儿童节目中的插播广告违规
  - 名人/影响者代言未标注

#### D. 《儿童在线隐私保护规则》(GDPR第8条+指南)
- **风险标记**：
  - 14岁以下受众的个性化广告
  - 未获得可验证的父母同意
  - 行为追踪/数据收集未披露

### 风险评分矩阵

| 合规维度 | 低风险 | 中风险 | 高风险 |
|---------|-------|-------|-------|
| 披露透明度 | 明确标记 | 模糊标记 | 无标记 |
| 年龄针对性 | 通用内容 | 混合受众 | 明确针对儿童 |
| 声称验证性 | 有证据支持 | 部分声称 | 未实质性声称 |
| 数据实践 | 最小收集 | 追踪但同意 | 追踪无同意 |

---

## 第四层：报告与可视化输出

### 检测结果架构

```json
{
  "video_id": "string",
  "commercial_content": {
    "detected": boolean,
    "types": ["native_advertising", "affiliate_marketing"],
    "confidence": 0.92
  },
  "product_classification": {
    "category": "energy_beverages",
    "risk_tier": "high",
    "age_sensitivity": "12+"
  },
  "compliance_flags": {
    "disclosure_clarity": {
      "status": "non-compliant",
      "issue": "商业意图未标记",
      "regulation": "2010/13/EU",
      "severity": "critical"
    },
    "misleading_claims": {
      "status": "flagged",
      "claims": ["增加体能", "改善注意力"],
      "evidence_status": "unsubstantiated",
      "regulation": "2005/29/EC",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    "influencer_compliance": {
      "status": "non-compliant",
      "issue": "影响者代言未披露",
      "regulation": "2005/29/EC + 2010/13/EU",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    "gdpr_data_practices": {
      "status": "warning",
      "issue": "链接产品的应用进行未同意追踪",
      "regulation": "GDPR Art.8",
      "severity": "medium"
    }
  },
  "audience_assessment": {
    "likely_minor_reach": 0.78,
    "channel_category": "gaming",
    "viewer_demographics": "primarily_under_18"
  },
  "recommendations": [
    "添加明确的商业披露标记",
    "删除未实质性支持的健康声称",
    "获取影响者代言的书面披露",
    "审查链接产品的儿童隐私设置"
  ]
}
```

### 仪表板指标
- **内容风险热图**：按产品类别和合规维度
- **频道合规趋势**：时间序列违规频率
- **欧盟成员国地区映射**：国家特定法律强度权重
- **影响者网络分析**：代言关系与披露一致性

---

## 实施考量

### 技术栈
- **自然语言处理**：多语言商业语言检测(英语、德语、法语、西班牙语等)
- **计算机视觉**：品牌识别、视觉商业标记
- **图知识库**：产品-类别-法规映射

### 局限性与透明度
- 文化差异：商业实践的地区规范差异
- 假阳性风险：讽刺/教育性内容误分类
- 法律滞后：新兴平台实践的监管覆盖不足

---

## 参考法律工具

| 指令 | 关键条款 | 实施成员国差异 |
|-----|--------|------------|
| 2010/13/EU(AVMSD) | 第9条:广告披露 | 德国严格;南欧执法宽松 |
| 2005/29/EC | 附件I:禁止实践 | 一致性高 |
| GDPR | 第8条:儿童同意 | 比利时(7岁);其他国家(16岁) |

此系统设计可扩展至TikTok、Instagram等平台的适应性修改。

pages.title: Overview
pages.content:
# ChildSafeAds — Commercial Content in Child-Facing YouTube Videos

**A shared task at [NLLP](https://nllpw.org) @ EMNLP 2026.**

Imagine you work at an authority responsible for monitoring commercial content that reaches minors on video platforms. How would you build that monitoring system, and what can it achieve at each level of data access and cost?

Influencer marketing reaching children and teenagers is widespread on YouTube and frequently undisclosed. Assessing it at platform scale needs automated support, but doing so responsibly means classifying what is being sold, categorising it, and reasoning about the advertising-law concerns it raises. This task puts those three together on real data.

## The Data

**3,360 instances**: train 2,353 / dev 504 / test 503, **channel-disjoint** (no channel appears in more than one split). Each instance is one sponsored segment, community-verified via SponsorBlock, on a channel curated to plausibly reach a significant teen audience, paired with the product page its description links to.

Fields are grouped into **four access levels ordered by collection cost**: the segment transcript, then video metadata including YouTube's own paid-promotion flag, then channel context, then the crawled product page. A transcript-only system uses one field; each further level costs more to obtain at scale.

## The Sub-Tasks

| | Task | Output |
|---|---|---|
| **ST1** | Commercial type | one label (EU Consumer Rights Directive contract types) |
| **ST2** | Product category | one or more labels |
| **ST3** | Compliance risk flags | one or more flags, grounded in EU consumer law (UCPD, AVMSD, DSA, CRD) |

Participate in any subset. Definitions are in `labels_taxonomy.md`, shipped with the data; per-flag legal grounding is in `legal_provisions.json` as citations and notes, not statutory text.

Two things are given by the dataset and should not be re-assessed by systems: the channel is child-facing, and the segment is commercial. The question is what is being sold and what concerns it raises.

## What We Are Actually Asking

Accuracy is scored on the leaderboard, but the interesting question is a design one: **what does each additional level of data buy, and is it worth the cost?** Every submission therefore records which data levels it used, and that appears on the leaderboard beside the score, so results read as *accuracy at a given data cost*. Beyond that one dropdown, we highly encourage a short **system design report** describing the trade-offs you weighed. It is not a full paper, and it is where the most interesting findings of this task are likely to live.

A **bonus track** invites teams to go further and collect off-platform destination data themselves (shops, terms of service, apps) starting from the outbound link we ship. Not scored, very welcome in the report.

## Getting Started

1. Register (approval required; registering accepts the data-use terms).
2. Download **Public Data** and the **Starting Kit** from the Participate tab.
3. Run the majority baseline to produce a valid submission, check it with the included format checker, and submit.

See the **Data**, **Evaluation**, and **Terms** pages for specifics.
pages.content_zh:
# ChildSafeAds — 儿童面向YouTube视频中的商业内容

**一项共同任务，在[NLLP](https://nllpw.org) @ EMNLP 2026举行。**

想象你在一个负责监督到达视频平台未成年人的商业内容的机构工作。你如何构建监控系统，以及在每个数据访问和成本级别，它能达到什么效果？

影响者营销到达儿童和青少年在YouTube上广泛存在，且经常未披露。在平台规模上评估它需要自动化支持，但负责任地进行此操作意味着分类正在销售的内容、对其进行分类，并推理其引发的广告法律问题。本任务在真实数据上将这三个方面结合在一起。

## 数据

**3,360个实例**：训练集2,353 / 开发集504 / 测试集503，**频道不相交**（任何频道不在多个分割中出现）。每个实例是一个赞助片段，通过SponsorBlock社区验证，在精心策划的可能到达大量青少年受众的频道上，配有其描述链接到的产品页面。

字段按**四个访问级别按收集成本排序**分组：片段文本记录、包括YouTube自有付费推广标志的视频元数据、频道上下文，以及爬取的产品页面。纯文本记录系统使用一个字段；每个进一步级别在规模上获取需要更多成本。

## 子任务

| | 任务 | 输出 |
|---|---|---|
| **ST1** | 商业类型 | 一个标签（EU消费者权益指令合同类型） |
| **ST2** | 产品类别 | 一个或多个标签 |
| **ST3** | 合规风险标志 | 一个或多个标志，基于EU消费者法（UCPD、AVMSD、DSA、CRD） |

可参与任何子集。定义在随数据提供的`labels_taxonomy.md`中；每个标志的法律依据在`legal_provisions.json`中作为引用和说明，而非法定文本。

数据集给出两点且系统不应重新评估：频道面向儿童，片段为商业内容。问题是销售的是什么以及它引发什么问题。

## 我们实际在询问的内容

准确度在排行榜上评分，但有趣的问题是设计问题：**每个额外的数据级别能买到什么，成本是否值得？** 因此每个提交都记录其使用了哪些数据级别，这出现在排行榜上分数旁边，所以结果读作*给定数据成本下的准确度*。除了那个下拉菜单外，我们高度鼓励一份简短的**系统设计报告**，描述你权衡的权衡。这不是完整论文，这是本任务最有趣的发现可能存在的地方。

**额外赛道**邀请团队进一步自行收集平台外目标数据（商店、服务条款、应用程序），从我们提供的出站链接开始。不计分，非常欢迎在报告中呈现。

## 入门

1. 注册（需要批准；注册即表示接受数据使用条款）。
2. 从"参与"标签下载**公开数据**和**入门工具包**。
3. 运行多数基线以生成有效提交、用包含的格式检查器检查，然后提交。

见**数据**、**评估**和**条款**页面了解具体信息。

pages.title: Data
pages.content:
# Data

## Where to Get It

The dataset is attached to each phase of this competition. Go to the **Participate** tab and download **Public Data**:

| Phase | File | Contents |
|-------|------|----------|
| Development | `public_data_dev.zip` | `train.jsonl` (2,353) and `dev.jsonl` (504), both labelled, plus documentation |
| Evaluation | `public_data_test.zip` | `test.jsonl` (503), unlabelled, plus documentation |

Test inputs are released when the evaluation phase opens. The **Starting Kit**, on the same tab, contains a loader for this format, a submission-format checker, a majority baseline, and a valid sample submission.

Each zip also contains `README.md` (dataset card), `labels_taxonomy.md` (full label definitions, severity, the direct-exhortation test, the bonus track) and `legal_provisions.json`.

## Format

Splits are **channel-disjoint**: no channel appears in more than one split. Each line of a JSONL file is one instance, with fields grouped into four access levels ordered by collection cost, so a system can use as much or as little as its design calls for.

| Level | Field | Contents | Collection cost |
|-------|-------|----------|-----------------|
| 1 | `transcript` | `text`, `segment_start`, `segment_end` | Lowest; scales to the whole platform |
| 2 | `video_context` | `videoID`, `title`, `description`, `official_disclosure` | One metadata call per video |
| 3 | `channel_context` | `channelID`, `channel_name` | One channel lookup |
| 4 | `product_page` | `raw_url`, `resolved_url`, `page_title`, `text` | Crawl the outbound link; some pages are dead or block automated access |

`official_disclosure` is YouTube's own "Includes paid promotion" label: `"true"`, `"false"`, or `""` when it could not be determined.

`train.jsonl` and `dev.jsonl` carry a `labels` block; `test.jsonl` does not.

```json
"labels": {
  "st1": "digital_content_or_services",
  "st2": ["apps", "gambling_adjacent"],
  "st3": ["undisclosed_advertising"],
  "st3_evidence": [{"flag": "undisclosed_advertising", "quote": "verbatim span from this instance's text"}]
}
```

Each `st3_evidence` quote is verbatim from that instance's own transcript, description, or product page. Quotes that could not be matched to the source are omitted, so a flag may carry no evidence entry.

## Labels and Legal Grounding

`labels_taxonomy.md` gives the full definitions. In brief: ST1 is single-label (what the buyer receives), ST2 is multi-label (what is being sold), ST3 is multi-label compliance flags, where `no_flag` and `insufficient_context` each stand alone.

`legal_provisions.json` maps each flag to the EU instruments and provisions that ground it, with a severity attribute and a note on what each provision requires. It holds **citations and notes, not statutory text**, and covers the provisions behind the flags in this release rather than the whole of EU advertising law. The identifiers resolve against EUR-Lex and Commission guidance if you want to retrieve fuller legal material yourself; whether doing so improves flag prediction is an open question we would like reports to address.

## Provenance and Curation

Channels were curated to plausibly reach a significant teen audience: an automated classifier over channel descriptions, video titles and metadata, followed by a human-validated exclusion pass. This is not guaranteed correct for every channel, but it means **systems do not need to assess audience themselves**; treat "child-facing" as a dataset-level property.

Labels are automatically annotated, with human validation and legal calibration. Some compliance flags remain under legal review and may be refined in a point release; any change will be announced on this competition. Human-annotated calibration examples will be released with the evaluation phase.

## Licence

The dataset derives from the [SponsorBlock](https://sponsor.ajay.app/database) database, licensed **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0**. Under that licence's share-alike term, the derived labels, instance structure and resolved page text are distributed under the same licence, attributing SponsorBlock. Video-derived fields are for research use under the task's terms. See the Terms page and the dataset `README.md`.
pages.content_zh:
# 数据

## 获取方式

数据集附加到此竞赛的每个阶段。请进入**参赛**选项卡并下载**公开数据**：

| 阶段 | 文件 | 内容 |
|------|------|------|
| 开发阶段 | `public_data_dev.zip` | `train.jsonl`（2,353条）和`dev.jsonl`（504条），均已标注，附带文档 |
| 评估阶段 | `public_data_test.zip` | `test.jsonl`（503条），未标注，附带文档 |

测试输入在评估阶段开启时发布。同一选项卡上的**启动工具包**包含该格式的加载器、提交格式检查器、多数基线和有效样本提交。

每个压缩包还包含`README.md`（数据集说明卡）、`labels_taxonomy.md`（完整标签定义、严重程度、直接劝说测试、额外任务）和`legal_provisions.json`。

## 格式

数据集划分采用**渠道隔离**方式：任何渠道仅出现在一个数据集中。JSONL文件的每一行代表一个实例，字段分为四个访问级别，按收集成本排序，以便系统根据需要使用相应的数据。

| 级别 | 字段 | 内容 | 收集成本 |
|------|------|------|---------|
| 1 | `transcript` | `text`、`segment_start`、`segment_end` | 最低；可扩展至整个平台 |
| 2 | `video_context` | `videoID`、`title`、`description`、`official_disclosure` | 每个视频一次元数据调用 |
| 3 | `channel_context` | `channelID`、`channel_name` | 一次频道查询 |
| 4 | `product_page` | `raw_url`、`resolved_url`、`page_title`、`text` | 爬取出站链接；部分页面已失效或阻止自动访问 |

`official_disclosure`是YouTube自身的"包含付费推广"标签：`"true"`、`"false"`或当无法确定时为`""`。

`train.jsonl`和`dev.jsonl`包含`labels`块；`test.jsonl`不包含。

```json
"labels": {
  "st1": "digital_content_or_services",
  "st2": ["apps", "gambling_adjacent"],
  "st3": ["undisclosed_advertising"],
  "st3_evidence": [{"flag": "undisclosed_advertising", "quote": "verbatim span from this instance's text"}]
}
```

每个`st3_evidence`引文来自该实例本身的转录文本、描述或产品页面的逐字段选。无法匹配到来源的引文被省略，因此一个标志可能不带任何证据条目。

## 标签和法律依据

`labels_taxonomy.md`提供完整定义。简言之：ST1是单标签（购买者获得的内容）、ST2是多标签（被销售的内容）、ST3是多标签合规标志，其中`no_flag`和`insufficient_context`各自独立。

`legal_provisions.json`将每个标志映射到为其提供依据的欧盟法律工具和条款，并附带严重程度属性和各条款要求的说明。它包含**引文和注释，而非法定条文**，涵盖本版本中标志后的条款而非整个欧盟广告法。标识符可根据EUR-Lex和委员会指南解析，如需检索更完整的法律材料；这样做是否改进标志预测是我们希望报告探讨的一个开放问题。

## 来源和策划

频道经过策划，合理覆盖重要的青少年受众：使用基于频道描述、视频标题和元数据的自动分类器，随后进行人工验证的排除审查。这对每个频道的准确性无法保证，但意味着**系统无需自行评估受众**；将"面向儿童"视为数据集级属性。

标签经过自动注释，并进行人工验证和法律校准。部分合规标志仍在法律审查中，可能在补丁版本中细化；任何变更将在此竞赛中公布。人工标注的校准示例将与评估阶段一同发布。

## 许可证

该数据集源自[SponsorBlock](https://sponsor.ajay.app/database)数据库，采用**CC BY-NC-SA 4.0**许可。根据该许可的共享条款，衍生标签、实例结构

pages.title: Evaluation
pages.content:
# Evaluation and Submission

## Phases

| Phase | Dates | Predict on | Submissions |
|-------|-------|-----------|-------------|
| Development | 20 July – 10 August 2026 | `dev.jsonl` | 10 per day |
| Evaluation | 11 – 18 August 2026 | `test.jsonl` | 3 in total |

The development phase has a live leaderboard for tuning. The evaluation phase determines the final ranking, so spend your three submissions carefully.

## Submission Format

Upload a **zip containing one JSONL file**, with one object per instance:

```json
{"instanceID": "...", "st1": "physical_goods", "st2": ["toys"], "st3": ["no_flag"]}
```

- Omit a field for any sub-task you are not entering. Missing predictions score 0 for that instance on that sub-task, so partial participation is fine but incomplete coverage is penalised.
- `st3` must respect exclusivity: `no_flag` and `insufficient_context` each stand alone.
- Validate before uploading with `check_submission.py` from the Starting Kit:
  `python check_submission.py submission.jsonl dev.jsonl`

## Metrics

All macro-F1, higher is better. Reported per submission:

| Key | Meaning |
|-----|---------|
| `mean_macro_f1` | Mean of the three sub-task scores. **Ranks the leaderboard.** |
| `st1_macro_f1` | Sub-task 1, single-label |
| `st2_macro_f1` | Sub-task 2, multi-label |
| `st3_macro_f1` | Sub-task 3, fine-grained flags |
| `st3_family_macro_f1` | Sub-task 3, flags collapsed to families (disclosure / content / product) |

The family-level score is reported because flag frequencies are heavily imbalanced, so a fine-grained macro-F1 alone can be dominated by rare flags. `coverage` (the share of reference instances you predicted) is also returned for diagnosis.

For reference, the majority-class baseline in the Starting Kit scores **0.093 mean macro-F1** on dev (ST1 0.151, ST2 0.042, ST3 0.085). It exists to establish the floor and to let you verify your pipeline end to end.

## The System Design Report (Highly Encouraged)

The leaderboard is only half of the evaluation. Because this task is about *how to build a monitoring system*, we highly encourage every team to describe their design. There are two parts to this, and neither requires writing a full paper.

### 1. The submission form (takes seconds)

Every submission carries a short questionnaire. **Only one answer is required:** which **data access levels** your system used. That answer appears as a column on the leaderboard next to your score, so results can be read as *accuracy at a given data cost*, which is the point of the task. A system using transcripts alone and scoring near one using the full crawl is a genuinely interesting result, and we want that visible.

The remaining questions are optional and exist so you can record, at whatever depth suits you: system type, a two-to-three sentence method summary, whether you retrieved legal material beyond the citations we ship, the approximate cost of running over all 3,360 instances, and a **link to a fuller report**.

Please complete the optional fields on your **final evaluation-phase submission**, even if you skip them while tuning.

### 2. A short document (optional but valuable)

If you can, write up the design in a few pages and paste the link (PDF, preprint, or repository) into the `report_url` field. Useful content:

- results at more than one access level, and what each level bought;
- cost, reliability, and scalability at platform scale;
- model and compute choices, and how they would generalise beyond this dataset;
- for ST3, the provisions your predictions relied on, and whether richer legal context helped.

Legal grounding is **not scored** on the leaderboard: we would rather report honestly on classification than score a component we cannot yet evaluate rigorously, so the report is where that work is recognised. Teams writing a full system description paper for the workshop are welcome to link that instead.

## Rules

Any model or resource is allowed, including LLMs, provided you document it in your report. Do not manually label the test set. One account per team. Please do not create multiple accounts to gain extra submissions.
pages.content_zh:
# 评估与提交

## 阶段

| 阶段 | 日期 | 预测对象 | 提交次数 |
|-------|-------|-----------|-------------|
| 开发 | 2026年7月20日 – 8月10日 | `dev.jsonl` | 每天10次 |
| 评估 | 2026年8月11日 – 18日 | `test.jsonl` | 共3次 |

开发阶段提供实时排行榜供调优使用。评估阶段决定最终排名，请谨慎使用你的三次提交机会。

## 提交格式

上传**包含一个JSONL文件的zip文件**，每个实例对应一个对象：

```json
{"instanceID": "...", "st1": "physical_goods", "st2": ["toys"], "st3": ["no_flag"]}
```

- 对于未参加的子任务，请省略相应字段。缺失的预测在该子任务上每个实例得分为0，因此部分参与是可以接受的，但覆盖不完整会被扣分。
- `st3`必须遵守互斥性：`no_flag`和`insufficient_context`各自独立。
- 在上传前使用初始工具包中的`check_submission.py`进行验证：
  `python check_submission.py submission.jsonl dev.jsonl`

## 评估指标

所有指标均为宏平均F1分数，分数越高越好。每次提交报告的指标：

| 键 | 含义 |
|-----|-------|
| `mean_macro_f1` | 三个子任务分数的平均值。**决定排行榜排名。** |
| `st1_macro_f1` | 子任务1，单标签 |
| `st2_macro_f1` | 子任务2，多标签 |
| `st3_macro_f1` | 子任务3，细粒度标志 |
| `st3_family_macro_f1` | 子任务3，标志合并到类别（披露/内容/产品） |

报告类别级分数是因为标志分布严重不均衡，仅有细粒度宏平均F1可能被稀有标志主导。还会返回`coverage`（你预测的参考实例所占份额）用于诊断。

作为参考，初始工具包中的多数类基线在开发集上得分为**0.093平均宏F1**（ST1 0.151，ST2 0.042，ST3 0.085）。这是为了建立下限，让你能够端到端验证流程。

## 系统设计报告（强烈推荐）

排行榜只是评估的一半。因为本任务旨在*构建监控系统的方法*，我们强烈建议每个团队描述其设计。这包括两个部分，均不需要写完整的论文。

### 1. 提交表格（只需数秒）

每次提交附带一份简短问卷。**只有一个答案是必需的：** 你的系统使用的**数据访问级别**。该答案会在排行榜上以列的形式显示在你的分数旁，这样结果可以理解为*特定数据成本下的精度*，这正是本任务的重点。仅使用转录文本的系统与使用完整爬取数据的系统分数接近是一个真正有趣的结果，我们希望这一点可见。

其余问题是可选的，存在的目的是让你记录（深度由你决定）：系统类型、两到三句的方法总结、是否检索了我们提供的引文之外的法律材料、在所有3,360个实例上运行的大约成本，以及**较完整报告的链接**。

请在**最终评估阶段提交**时填写可选字段，即使你在调优期间跳过它们。

### 2. 一份简短文档（可选但有价值）

如果可能的话，用几页篇幅写出设计说明，并将链接（PDF、预印本或代码库）粘贴到`report_url`字段。有用的内容包括：

- 多个访问级别的结果，以及每个级别带来了什么；
- 平台规模的成本、可靠性和可扩展性；
- 模型和计算选择，以及它们如何超越本数据集推广；
- 对于ST3，你的预测所依赖的条款，以及更丰富的法律背景是否提供帮助。

法律基础**不在排行榜上计分**：我们更希望诚实报告分类，而不是给无法严格评估的组件评分，所以报告是该工作被认可的地方。撰写研讨会论文的完整系统描述的团队欢迎链接该论文。

## 规则

允许使用任何模型或资源，包括大语言模型，只要你在

# Terms and Conditions

By registering for this competition you agree to the following.

## Data Use

1. **Research use within this shared task.** The data is provided for research participation in ChildSafeAds. Using it to train systems for other purposes requires separate permission from the organisers.
2. **Licence.** The dataset derives from the [SponsorBlock](https://sponsor.ajay.app/database) database, licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Under that licence's share-alike term, the labels, instance structure and resolved page text are distributed under the same **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0**, attributing SponsorBlock: non-commercial use, share-alike, with attribution. Video-derived fields (transcripts, titles, descriptions, metadata) are provided for research use under these terms. Resolved page text is extracted from third-party commercial websites and is likewise research-use only.
3. **Platform terms.** You must comply with the YouTube Terms of Service when using any video-derived field or when collecting further data yourself.
4. **No re-identification or contact.** Do not attempt to re-identify, contact, or harass creators, channels, or any individual appearing in the data. Do not publish material that singles out an individual creator as non-compliant; findings should be reported in aggregate.
5. **Redistribution.** Do not redistribute the dataset outside your team. Direct others to this competition instead.

## Competition Conduct

6. **Do not manually label the test set.** Predictions on the evaluation phase must be produced by your system.
7. **One account per team.** Do not create additional accounts to obtain extra submissions.
8. **Document your system.** Any model or resource is permitted, including LLMs, provided it is documented in your system design report.

## A Note on the Labels

The compliance labels reflect the organisers' reading of EU consumer law for the purposes of a research benchmark. They are **not legal advice and not a finding of unlawfulness** about any creator, brand, or video. Some flags remain under legal review and may be refined in a point release.

## Bonus Track

If you collect off-platform destination data yourself, you remain responsible for doing so lawfully and for respecting the terms of the sites you access.

## Organisers

Thales Bertaglia (Utrecht University), Catalina Goanta (Utrecht University), Gerasimos Spanakis (Maastricht University), Güneş Acar (Radboud University).

Questions: please use the competition forum, so answers reach all participants.

pages.title: Overview
pages.content:
# Welcome to the UUSIVC 2026 Challenge

Welcome to the **Universal UltraSound Image & Video Analysis Challenge 2026: Multi-Organ Classification and Segmentation Across B-mode and Contrast-Enhanced Ultrasound**.

This challenge focuses on evaluating algorithms for multi-organ, multi-modal ultrasound image and video analysis. The benchmark covers classification and segmentation tasks across B-mode ultrasound images, contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) videos, and cardiac ultrasound videos. The goal is to advance the generalizability, robustness, and clinical applicability of AI models in ultrasound image analysis.

🧪Participants will benchmark their methods via Codabench through automated submission and evaluation pipelines, with live leaderboards tracking performance across classification and segmentation tasks.

🏆Challenge results and winners will be announced during the [Deep-Breath 2026: 3rd Deep Breast Workshop on AI and Imaging for Diagnostic and Treatment Challenges in Breast Care Workshop](https://deep-breath-miccai.github.io/deepbreath-2026/), held in conjunction with [MICCAI 2026](https://conferences.miccai.org/2026/en/default.asp) in Strasbourg, France.

🌐For updates, guidelines, dataset access, and community discussions, visit the [UUSIVC2026 website](https://uusivc2026-sudo.github.io/uusivc2026.github.io/).

📄 The full challenge proposal is available [here](https://zenodo.org/records/19729665).

🔗[Baseline](https://github.com/uusivc2026-sudo/UUSIVC-2026-Challenge). It provides one possible implementation path for participating in the challenge. Participants are encouraged to explore their own approaches and develop more competitive, state-of-the-art research algorithms.

## Registration

Participants must register their team name and provide their details through a [Google Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfbO05JF__QkYzL77rdGwoFb3stit-3S5zcbVh4ALYcKjJ7AQ/viewform) before accessing the data and submitting their results. Each team has a maximum of **3 members**, including the team leader. Please ensure that you provide accurate **Codabench** usernames to enable access to data and submission permissions.

## Dataset

The UUSIVC 2026 dataset is composed of multiple public ultrasound datasets and private datasets collected in collaboration with partner hospitals.

The benchmark includes:

- B-mode ultrasound image classification.
- B-mode ultrasound image segmentation.
- CEUS video/sequence classification.
- CEUS video/frame segmentation.
- Cardiac ultrasound video/frame segmentation.

Datasets are available through two independent download sources. Please choose either one of the following links to download the dataset:

- [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/WyattH/UUSIVC2026/tree/main)
- [Baidu Netdisk](https://pan.baidu.com/s/1_8ZDKJdsR1dCsOf7XzG_ew?pwd=usvc)

Each download source contains both the training and validation data. The training set includes the input data together with the corresponding sample-level labels for classification tasks and pixel-level annotations for segmentation tasks. The validation set contains only the input data, without labels or annotations.


## Tasks

Participants are encouraged to develop a unified model or pipeline capable of handling multiple organs, modalities, and task types.
	
The online validation benchmark includes five task groups:

- **image_cls**: ultrasound image classification.
- **ceus_cls**: CEUS video/sequence classification.
- **image_seg**: 2D ultrasound image segmentation.
- **ceus_seg**: CEUS video/frame segmentation.
- **video_seg**: cardiac ultrasound video/frame segmentation.

The target organs and datasets include breast, thyroid, liver, prostate, appendix, kidney, fetal head, and cardiac structures, depending on the task type.

Representative tasks include:

- Breast lesion classification and segmentation.
- Liver disease classification.
- Appendix classification.
- Thyroid nodule segmentation.
- Kidney contour segmentation.
- Fetal head contour segmentation.
- Cardiac structure segmentation.
- Prostate image classification and segmentation.
- Cardiac video structure segmentation.
- CEUS-based classification and lesion segmentation.

Each organ is associated with a distinct clinical task, exemplifying the multi-disease and multi-task nature of the challenge. In addition to the public datasets, we will provide a small portion of our private datasets for training to mitigate domain gap difficulties. The validation and test sets will primarily consist of private data, where the validation labels and test sets will not be publicly disclosed.

## Timeline

| Phase | Dates          | Details                                                                      |
|---|----------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Development Phase | June 29, 2026  | Website opens for registration, release training and validation images. |
| Validation Phase | June 29, 2026  | Submission system opens for validation.                                     |
| Paper Phase | Aug. 25, 2026 | Short paper and docker submission deadline.                                  |
| Test Phase | Aug. 26, 2026 | Submission system for testing.                                         |
| Workshop | Sept. 27, 2026 | Final results are released during the Deep-Breath workshop at MICCAI 2026.    |

## Submission Guidelines

We provide guides on how to develop model, infer and submit results in the validation phase, as well as how to prepare and submit the Docker file of the model in the testing phase. Please see the **Submission Guidelines** page.

## Rules

### Methods

Participants are allowed to base their methods on existing open-source general models. And they are invited to submit a short paper (refer to Technical Report page) to the Deep-Breath workshop to introduce the details of their methods and declare innovations in areas such as preprocessing, model architecture, or post-processing.

### Use of other training data/pre-trained models
No additional data allowed;
The publicly available pre-trained model, such as ResNet50 trained on ImageNet, can be used. To ensure fairness and reproducibility of results, using unpublished pre-trained models is prohibited.

### Award Eligibility
As a condition for being ranked and considered as the challenge winner or eligible for any prize, the teams/participants must fulfil the following obligations:

- Present their method at the final event of the challenge at MICCAI 2026;
- Submit a paper to Deep-Breath workshop reporting the details of the methods in a short or long (up to the teams) LNCS format;
- Sign and return all prize acceptance documents as may be required by Competition Sponsor/Organizers;
- Commit to citing the data challenge paper and the data overview paper whenever submitting the developed method for scientific and non-scientific publications.

## Awards
Top-10 teams will be invited to present talks and winning certificates will be provided.

We will provide a prize of 9,900 CNY for the Top 10 teams.

- 1st Place: 2,500 CNY
- 2nd-3rd Place: 1,500 CNY
- 4th-6th Place: 1,200 CNY
- 7th-10th Place: 500 CNY

Sponsors for the awards are currently being investigated.

The challenge organizers aim to publish a summary paper in a relevant journal. The top ten performing teams will be invited to as co-authors. Participants can submit their own paper after submitting the summary paper or once the challenge paper is published on Arxiv.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
You can view the full FAQ on the corresponding page. And please do not hesitate to email us ([uusivc2026@gmail.com](mailto:uusivc2026@gmail.com)) if you have any questions.

# 欢迎来到UUSIVC 2026挑战赛

欢迎参加**通用超声图像与视频分析挑战赛2026：B模式和对比增强超声跨多器官分类与分割**。

本挑战赛致力于评估多器官、多模态超声图像和视频分析算法。基准测试涵盖B模式超声图像、对比增强超声(CEUS)视频和心脏超声视频的分类和分割任务。目标是推进超声图像分析中AI模型的泛化能力、鲁棒性和临床适用性。

🧪参与者将通过Codabench平台进行基准测试，利用自动化提交和评估管道，实时排行榜跟踪分类和分割任务的性能表现。

🏆挑战赛结果和获奖者将在[Deep-Breath 2026: 第3届Deep Breast工作坊——乳腺影像诊断和治疗挑战中的AI和影像学](https://deep-breath-miccai.github.io/deepbreath-2026/)期间公布，该工作坊与[MICCAI 2026](https://conferences.miccai.org/2026/en/default.asp)在法国斯特拉斯堡联合举办。

🌐如需了解最新信息、获取指南、数据集访问权限和社区讨论，请访问[UUSIVC2026网站](https://uusivc2026-sudo.github.io/uusivc2026.github.io/)。

📄完整的挑战赛方案可在[此处](https://zenodo.org/records/19729665)获取。

🔗[基准实现](https://github.com/uusivc2026-sudo/UUSIVC-2026-Challenge)。它提供了参与挑战赛的一种可能的实现路径。鼓励参与者探索自己的方法，开发更具竞争力的、最先进的研究算法。

## 数据集

UUSIVC 2026数据集由多个公开超声数据集和与合作医院共同收集的私有数据集组成。

基准测试包括：

数据集可通过两个独立的下载来源获取。请选择以下链接之一下载数据集：

## 任务

鼓励参与者开发能够处理多个器官、多种模态和多种任务类型的统一模型或管道。

# Submission Guidelines

This page describes the required submission format for the validation and testing phases.

**Important: Participants should register their team name and participants via a [Google Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfbO05JF__QkYzL77rdGwoFb3stit-3S5zcbVh4ALYcKjJ7AQ/viewform) before participating.**

## Development Phase

To help participants quickly get familiar with the data processing and model building workflow, we provide the training code and pre-trained weights for our baseline model [here](https://github.com/uusivc2026-sudo/UUSIVC-2026-Challenge). Participants are encouraged to use this baseline as a starting point to build and customize their own approach, or alternatively, develop a completely new method from scratch based on their own ideas.

## Submission type

The validation phase uses **result submission**.

Participants should submit prediction files. The submitted archive should contain:

```text
classification.json
image_seg/<Dataset>/masks/*.png
ceus_seg/<Dataset>/annotations/*.npz
video_seg/<Dataset>/annotations/*.npz
```

The top level of the zip file must directly contain `classification.json`, `image_seg`, `ceus_seg`, and `video_seg`. Do not wrap them inside an extra parent folder.

Correct:

```text
submission.zip
-- classification.json
-- image_seg/
-- ceus_seg/
-- video_seg/
```

Incorrect:

```text
submission.zip
-- my_submission_folder/
    -- classification.json
    -- image_seg/
    -- ceus_seg/
    -- video_seg/
```

## Classification prediction format

Task4 ImageCls includes Appendix, Breast, Liver, and Prostate. Task5 CEUSCls includes BreastCEUS, LiverCEUS, ProstateCEUS, and ThyroidCEUS.


Classification predictions should be saved in a JSON file named:

```text
classification.json
```

The JSON should map either `sample_id` or `input_path_relative` to a prediction object. We recommend using `input_path_relative` because it is easy to match with `datalist.json`.

Example:

```json
{
  "ceus_cls/Breast/videos/cls_00000.npy": {
    "prediction": 1,
    "probability": [0.2, 0.8]
  },
  "image_cls/Appendix/imgs/cls_00000.jpg": {
    "prediction": 0,
    "probability": [0.9, 0.1]
  }
}
```

Fields:

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `prediction` | Predicted class index. |
| `probability` | Class probability list. |

For binary classification tasks, `probability` should contain two values:

## Image segmentation prediction format

Task1 ImageSeg includes Breast, Fetal Head, Heart, Kidney, Thyroid, and Prostate.


For `image_seg`, predictions should be grayscale mask images.

Required folder structure:

```text
image_seg/<Dataset>/masks/<mask_name>.png
```

Example:

```text
image_seg/Breast/masks/seg_mask_00000.png
image_seg/Thyroid/masks/seg_mask_00000.png
image_seg/Prostate/masks/seg_mask_00000.png
```

Mask requirements:

- Single-channel grayscale PNG is recommended.
- Background should be `0`.
- Foreground can be any non-zero value, preferably `255`.
- If the submitted mask size differs from the reference size, the scorer will resize the prediction to the reference size using nearest-neighbor interpolation.

## CEUS segmentation prediction format

For `ceus_seg`, predictions should be saved as `.npz` files under:

```text
ceus_seg/<Dataset>/annotations/<annotation_name>.npz
```

Example:

```text
ceus_seg/BreastCEUS/annotations/seg_annotation_00000.npz
ceus_seg/LiverCEUS/annotations/seg_annotation_00000.npz
```

The expected `.npz` file should contain a key named `mask`:

```python
import numpy as np

mask = np.zeros((256, 512), dtype=np.uint8)
# mask[predicted_foreground > 0] = 255
np.savez("seg_annotation_00000.npz", mask=mask)
```

Mask requirements:

- `mask` should be a 2D array.
- Background should be `0`.
- Foreground can be any non-zero value, preferably `255`.

## Video segmentation prediction format

For `video_seg`, predictions should be saved as `.npz` files under:

```text
video_seg/<Dataset>/annotations/<annotation_name>.npz
```

Example:

```text
video_seg/CardiacCH/annotations/seg_annotation_00000.npz
```

The expected `.npz` file should contain a dictionary named `fnum_mask`, where each key is a frame index and each value is a 2D mask array.

Example:

```python
import numpy as np

fnum_mask = {
    "0": np.zeros((256, 256), dtype=np.uint8),
    "14": np.zeros((256, 256), dtype=np.uint8),
    "33": np.zeros((256, 256), dtype=np.uint8),
}

np.savez("seg_annotation_00000.npz", fnum_mask=fnum_mask)
```

Mask requirements:

- Keys should match the annotated frame indices provided in `datalist.json`.
- Each mask should be a 2D array.
- Background should be `0`.
- Foreground can be any non-zero value, preferably `255`.

## Submission archive checklist

Before uploading, check that the zip file directly contains the required prediction files and folders:

```text
submission.zip
-- classification.json
-- image_seg/
-- ceus_seg/
-- video_seg/
```

## Validation scoring

The online validation ranking is based on evaluation metrics only.

For classification datasets:

```text
classification dataset score = 0.5 * Accuracy + 0.5 * AUC
```

For segmentation samples or annotated frames:

```text
case/frame segmentation score = 0.7 * DSC + 0.3 * NSD
```

Dataset-level and task-family scores are aggregated using dataset-size-based weights.

The online validation score is:

```text
overall_score = mean(Task1, Task2, Task3, Task4, Task5)
```

Efficiency metrics such as runtime and GPU memory are not included in the online validation ranking.

## Testing Phase

### Submission Requirements
During the testing phase, each team must submit:
- A Docker image containing your method
    - This image will be used by the organizers to run and evaluate your model.
    - Please follow the Docker building instructions.
- A 4-page technical report in Word or PDF format, which must include:
  - Team Name
  - Team Leader’s Name
  - Team Members
  - Affiliation
  - The content should describe your approach, methodology, and any important implementation details.

### Submission Method
Please send both files by email to the organizing committee:

- Email Address: [uusivc2026@gmail.com](uusivc2026@gmail.com)
- Subject Format: UUSIC-Testing Phase Submission-[TeamName]
- Attachments:
  - Docker image file (or a link to download it) or Docker Hub link
  - Technical report (Word or PDF)

## Important Notes
Only teams that submit both the Docker image and the technical report will be eligible to:

- Participate in the testing phase
- Appear in the final ranking
- Receive prize awards
- Be included as co-authors in the post-challenge paper
- Submissions that do not follow the Docker build instructions may fail to run during evaluation.

# Scoring Formulas

The algorithm will be assessed using the following metrics, and all metrics will be used to compute the ranking. The implementation of the used metrics can be found [here](https://github.com/uusic2025/challenge/blob/main/evaluation/metrics.py)

## Segmentation Metrics

### Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC)

Dice Similarity Coefficient measures the overlap between the predicted segmentation mask and the ground-truth segmentation mask.

### Normalized Surface Dice (NSD)

Normalized Surface Dice evaluates boundary agreement between the predicted mask and the ground-truth mask within a tolerance distance.


## Classification Metrics

### Area Under Curve (AUC)

Area Under Curve evaluates classification performance across decision thresholds.

### Accuracy

Accuracy measures the proportion of correctly classified samples.


## Task-wise Scores

The validation leaderboard is organized into five task groups:

- **Task1 ImageSeg**: B-mode ultrasound image segmentation, including Breast, Fetal Head, Heart, Kidney, Thyroid, and Prostate.
- **Task2 CEUSSeg**: CEUS lesion segmentation, including BreastCEUS, LiverCEUS, ProstateCEUS, and ThyroidCEUS.
- **Task3 VideoSeg**: cardiac ultrasound video/frame segmentation, including CardiacCH.
- **Task4 ImageCls**: B-mode ultrasound image classification, including Appendix, Breast, Liver, and Prostate.
- **Task5 CEUSCls**: CEUS video/sequence classification, including BreastCEUS, LiverCEUS, ProstateCEUS, and ThyroidCEUS.

For each classification dataset:

```text
dataset score = 0.5 * Accuracy + 0.5 * AUC
```

For each segmentation sample or annotated frame:

```text
case/frame score = 0.7 * DSC + 0.3 * NSD
```

Each task score is the sample-weighted average of its datasets. The online validation ranking score is the equal-weighted average of the five task scores:

```text
overall_score = mean(Task1, Task2, Task3, Task4, Task5)
```

## Online Validation Ranking

The online validation leaderboard is ranked by performance metrics only. Efficiency terms such as running time and GPU memory are not included in the Codabench validation score because validation submissions are prediction files and are not executed in a unified hardware environment.

For the final test stage, selected teams will submit Docker containers. The organizers will run the containers offline on unified hardware and may report computational efficiency separately.

# 评分公式

该算法将使用以下指标进行评估，所有指标都将用于计算排名。使用指标的实现可以在[这里](https://github.com/uusic2025/challenge/blob/main/evaluation/metrics.py)找到。

## 分割指标

### Dice 相似系数 (DSC)

Dice 相似系数衡量预测分割掩膜与真实值分割掩膜之间的重叠程度。

### 归一化表面 Dice (NSD)

归一化表面 Dice 评估预测掩膜与真实值掩膜在容差距离内的边界一致性。


## 分类指标

### 曲线下面积 (AUC)

曲线下面积评估分类模型在不同决策阈值下的性能。

### 准确度

准确度衡量正确分类样本的比例。


## 任务级评分

验证排行榜分为五个任务组：

- **任务1 ImageSeg**：B模式超声图像分割，包括乳腺、胎儿头部、心脏、肾脏、甲状腺和前列腺。
- **任务2 CEUSSeg**：造影超声病灶分割，包括乳腺造影超声、肝脏造影超声、前列腺造影超声和甲状腺造影超声。
- **任务3 VideoSeg**：心脏超声视频/帧分割，包括心脏造影超声。
- **任务4 ImageCls**：B模式超声图像分类，包括阑尾、乳腺、肝脏和前列腺。
- **任务5 CEUSCls**：造影超声视频/序列分类，包括乳腺造影超声、肝脏造影超声、前列腺造影超声和甲状腺造影超声。

对于每个分类数据集：

```text
数据集评分 = 0.5 × 准确度 + 0.5 × AUC
```

对于每个分割样本或标注帧：

```text
样本/帧评分 = 0.7 × DSC + 0.3 × NSD
```

每个任务评分是其数据集的样本加权平均值。在线验证排名评分是五个任务评分的等权平均值：

```text
总体评分 = 平均值(任务1, 任务2, 任务3, 任务4, 任务5)
```

## 在线验证排名

在线验证排行榜仅按性能指标排名。由于验证提交是预测文件，不在统一硬件环境中执行，因此评分中不包含运行时间和GPU显存等效率指标。

对于最终测试阶段，入选团队需提交Docker容器。组织者将在统一硬件上离线运行这些容器，并可能单独报告计算效率。

17556.title: 2026 “金睛杯”光学时敏弱小目标探测挑战赛（赛道二：基于事件相机的运动小目标检测）
17556.description:
光学时敏弱小目标探测是智能视觉感知领域中的重要研究方向，也是复杂环境下目标探测与态势感知中的关键技术问题。与常规目标检测任务相比，弱小目标通常存在成像尺度小、目标能量弱、背景干扰强、目标形态不稳定等特点，单帧图像中可利用的信息十分有限，算法在真实场景中容易出现漏检、误检和检测结果不连续等问题。
本次挑战赛依托 CSIG2026 学术会议平台，围绕光学时敏弱小目标探测中的关键问题，设置"红外视频卫星空中动目标检测"和"基于事件相机的运动小目标检测"两个赛道，为参赛队伍提供公平、可复现的算法验证平台，推动相关数据建设、方法创新和技术交流。
17556.description_zh:
Optical Time-Sensitive Weak-Small Target Detection is an important research direction in intelligent visual perception and a key technical challenge in target detection and situation awareness in complex environments. Compared to conventional target detection tasks, weak-small targets typically exhibit characteristics such as small imaging scale, weak target energy, strong background interference, and unstable target morphology. The usable information in a single frame image is extremely limited, and algorithms are prone to issues such as missed detections, false detections, and discontinuous detection results in real-world scenarios.

This challenge competition, based on the CSIG2026 academic conference platform, focuses on key problems in optical time-sensitive weak-small target detection, and sets up two competition tracks: "Infrared Video Satellite Airborne Moving Target Detection" and "Motion Small Target Detection Based on Event Camera". It provides participating teams with a fair and reproducible algorithm validation platform, promoting advances in related data construction, method innovation, and technical exchange.

pages.title: 赛事说明
pages.content:
## 挑战赛的目的 **通过本次挑战赛促进科研技术的交流研讨和应用推广** 本次挑战赛旨在依托 CSIG2026 学术会议平台，围绕光学时敏弱小目标探测中的关键问题，搭建面向学术界和产业界的开放竞赛与交流平台，吸引更多高校、科研院所和企业团队参与红外视频小目标检测、事件相机小目标检测等方向的研究。 **通过本次挑战赛促进光学时敏弱小目标探测技术发展** 通过竞赛汇聚工业界和学术界的智慧与力量，促进相关算法、数据集和评价体系的共同发展，推动领域垂类大模型发展与应用，加速技术创新和产业推广。 --- ## 挑战赛的意义 **光学时敏弱小目标探测应用广泛，关键技术问题突出** 光学时敏弱小目标探测是智能视觉感知领域中的重要研究方向，也是复杂环境下目标探测与态势感知中的关键技术问题。弱小目标通常存在成像尺度小、目标能量弱、背景干扰强、目标形态不稳定等特点，单帧图像中可利用的信息十分有限。 **红外视频卫星目标检测亟需融合时域信息与轨迹关联** 卫星视角下的红外视频弱小目标往往具有成像距离远、信噪比低、背景复杂、运动轨迹细弱等特点，仅依靠单帧检测难以获得稳定结果，需要进一步结合多帧时域信息、运动一致性和目标轨迹关联关系。 **事件相机小目标检测亟需发挥事件流时空连续性优势** 事件相机能够以异步方式感知亮度变化，具有高时间分辨率、低延迟、高动态范围和低数据冗余等优势。面向事件点云和事件流的时空建模方法发展，对于提升复杂场景下运动小目标的检测能力具有重要意义。 **公开数据和统一评测标准有助于推动领域发展** 红外视频卫星目标和事件相机小目标相关公开数据仍相对有限，真实场景数据获取和标注成本较高。本次竞赛通过开放具有针对性的数据资源和统一评测标准，为参赛队伍提供公平、可复现的算法验证平台。 --- ## 任务设置 ### 赛道一：红外视频卫星空中动目标检测 赛道一的主要任务是对视频中的红外小目标的质心进行预测，附加任务是对目标进行跟踪。参赛队伍根据红外小目标图像特点自行设计相关算法，使用主办方提供的数据集进行模型训练，最终以召回率（Recall）、精确率（Precision）和 F1 分数作为评价指标，以及轨迹完整度和轨迹准确度作为附加评价指标，衡量参赛队伍算法模型的性能。 ### 赛道二：基于事件相机的运动小目标检测 赛道二的主要任务是对事件流中的目标事件进行逐事件分割。参赛队伍根据事件小目标特性自行设计相关算法，使用主办方提供的事件数据集进行模型训练，最终以交并比（IoU）、准确率（ACC）、检测率（Pd）和虚警率（Fa）作为主要评价指标，衡量参赛队伍算法模型的性能。 --- ## 数据集简介 ### 赛道一数据集简介 竞赛数据集由国防科技大学与武汉大学联合开发，包括：基于热红外卫星的 IRAir 数据集、基于 Landsat 卫星的 IRSatVideo-LEO 数据集、基于高分四号卫星的 IRSatVideo-GEO 数据集，以及实测卫星热红外视频数据，共 1400 段视频序列（1000 段用于训练，200 段用于验证，200 段用于测试）。比赛开始前，将发布训练集和验证集视频及掩码标注；进入评测阶段时公布测试集视频，测试集标签不公开。 | 数据集 | 数据集简介 | 图像与目标示意 | | :---: | :---: | :---: | | IRAir | 数据来源：热红外 SDG 卫星一号图像，仿真目标
目标特点：飞机，低轨，暗目标
分辨率：256×256 | | | IRSatVideo-LEO | 数据来源：Landsat 卫星图像，仿真目标
目标特点：低轨，亮目标，短波红外
分辨率：1024×1024 | | | IRSatVideo-GEO | 数据来源：高分四号卫星图像，仿真目标
目标特点：地球同步轨道，中波红外，弱目标
分辨率：742×733（平均） | | | 实测热红外视频数据 | 数据来源：实测卫星热红外视频
目标特点：长波
分辨率：512×640 | | ### 赛道二数据集简介 基于 DAVIS346 事件相机的 EV-UAV 数据集作为训练、验证和测试数据集。总共 147 段序列（99 段用于训练，24 段用于验证，24 段用于测试）。（暂定） | 数据集 | 数据集简介 | 图像与目标示意 | | :---: | :---: | :---:| | EV-UAV  | 数据来源：DAVIS346 事件相机实拍
分辨率：346×260 | | --- ## 挑战赛评价方式 ### 赛道一评价方式 本次挑战赛赛道一的算法评价指标为召回率（Recall）和精确率（Precision），附加评价指标为轨迹完整度、轨迹准确度。算法最终评分结果由 F1 分数和附加分数组成。 $$ Recall = \frac{TD}{AT}, \quad Precision = \frac{TD}{TD + FD} $$ $$ F1 = \frac{2 \times Recall \times Precision}{Recall + Precision} $$ $$ TrackCompleteness = \frac{NTA}{N}, \quad TrackAccuracy = \frac{NTA}{NA} $$ | 附加得分项 | 阈值一 | 阈值二 | 阈值三 | | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | | 轨迹完整度得分 | ≥25%：+2分 | ≥35%：+3分 | ≥50%：+5分 | | 轨迹准确度得分 | ≥55%：+2分 | ≥65%：+3分 | ≥80%：+5分 | 最终得分为 F1 分数 × 100 + 附加得分，满分为 110 分。 --- ### 赛道二评价方式 赛道二的算法评价指标为交并比（IoU）、准确率（Acc）、检测率（Pd）和虚警率（Fa），最终评分结果由各指标加权得分。 $$ IoU = \frac{GT \cap Pred}{GT \cup Pred}, \quad Acc = \frac{TP_{target}}{TP_{target} + FN_{target}} $$ $$ Pd = \frac{TD}{AT}, \quad Fa = \frac{FD}{N_{frame} \times H \times W} $$ $$ Score_{Fa} = e^{-10000 \times Fa} $$ $$ Score = 0.4Pd + 0.3Score_{Fa} + 0.2IoU + 0.1Acc $$ --- ## 结果提交方式 **结果提交格式、提交入口和提交次数限制**：待补充 **提交内容与时间要求**：参赛队伍须在规定时间内提交测试结果，并在后继阶段提交算法代码、模型文件及算法报告。组委会将对各参赛队伍进行真实性审查。 **真实性与可复现性要求**：为避免参赛队伍滥用其他数据集或验证集标签信息用于算法训练，参赛队伍需提供算法训练时的相关参数，确保算法结果可复现。如发现违规使用数据信息或算法结果无法复现，组委会将按赛事规则处理。 --- ## 专题研讨会 组委会将举办挑战赛技术论坛，邀请获得一、二等奖的参赛队伍参加作特邀技术报告。 --- ## 知识产权归属 参赛队伍提交的算法及可执行模型的知识产权归参赛团队所有，比赛数据集归主办方所有。 各参赛队伍需要承诺提交的结果可重复，组织方承诺履行保密义务，并不用于除本挑战赛外的任何其他用途。 参赛队伍应保证所提供的方案、算法属于自有知识产权。组织方对参赛队伍因使用本队提供完成的算法和结果而产生的任何实际侵权或者被任何第三方指控侵权概不负责。一旦上述情况和事件发生，参赛队伍必须承担一切相关法律责任和经济赔偿责任并保护组织方免于承担该等责任。

分辨率：346×260 | | --- ## 挑战赛评价方式 ### 赛道一评价方式 本次挑战赛赛道一的算法评价指标为召回率（Recall）和精确率（Precision），附加评价指标为轨迹完整度、轨迹准确度。算法最终评分结果由 F1 分数和附加分数组成。 $$ Recall = \frac{TD}{AT}, \quad Precision = \frac{TD}{TD + FD} $$ $$ F1 = \frac{2 \times Recall \times Precision}{Recall + Precision} $$ $$ TrackCompleteness = \frac{NTA}{N}, \quad TrackAccuracy = \frac{NTA}{NA} $$ | 附加得分项 | 阈值一 | 阈值二 | 阈值三 | | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | | 轨迹完整度得分 | ≥25%：+2分 | ≥35%：+3分 | ≥50%：+5分 | | 轨迹准确度得分 | ≥55%：+2分 | ≥65%：+3分 | ≥80%：+5分 | 最终得分为 F1 分数 × 100 + 附加得分，满分为 110 分。 --- ### 赛道二评价方式 赛道二的算法评价指标为交并比（IoU）、准确率（Acc）、检测率（Pd）和虚警率（Fa），最终评分结果由各指标加权得分。 $$ IoU = \frac{GT \cap Pred}{GT \cup Pred}, \quad Acc = \frac{TP_{target}}{TP_{target} + FN_{target}} $$ $$ Pd = \frac{TD}{AT}, \quad Fa = \frac{FD}{N_{frame} \times H \times W} $$ $$ Score_{Fa} = e^{-10000 \times Fa} $$ $$ Score = 0.4Pd + 0.3Score_{Fa} + 0.2IoU + 0.1Acc $$ --- ## 结果提交方式 **结果提交格式、提交入口和提交次数限制**：待补充 **提交内容与时间要求**：参赛队伍须在规定时间内提交测试结果，并在后继阶段提交算法代码、模型文件及算法报告。组委会将对各参赛队伍进行真实性审查。 **真实性与可复现性要求**：为避免参赛队伍滥用其他数据集或验证集标签信息用于算法训练，参赛队伍需提供算法训练时的相关参数，确保算法结果可复现。如发现违规使用数据信息或算法结果无法复现，组委会将按赛事规则处理。 --- ## 专题研讨会 组委会将举办挑战赛技术论坛，邀请获得一、二等奖的参赛队伍参加作特邀技术报告。 --- ## 知识产权归属 参赛队伍提交的算法及可执行模型的知识产权归参赛团队所有，比赛数据集归主办方所有。 各参赛队伍需要承诺提交的结果可重复，组织方承诺履行保密义务，并不用于除本挑战赛外的任何其他用途。 参赛队伍应保证所提供的方案、算法属于自有知识产权。组织方对参赛队伍因使用本队提供完成的算法和结果而产生的任何实际侵权或者被任何第三方指控侵权概不负责。一旦上述情况和事件发生，参赛队伍必须承担一切相关法律责任和经济赔偿责任并保护组织方免于承担该等责任。

17555.title: 2026 “金睛杯”光学时敏弱小目标探测挑战赛（赛道一：红外视频卫星空中动目标检测）
17555.description:
光学时敏弱小目标探测是智能视觉感知领域中的重要研究方向，也是复杂环境下目标探测与态势感知中的关键技术问题。与常规目标检测任务相比，弱小目标通常存在成像尺度小、目标能量弱、背景干扰强、目标形态不稳定等特点，单帧图像中可利用的信息十分有限，算法在真实场景中容易出现漏检、误检和检测结果不连续等问题。
本次挑战赛依托 CSIG2026 学术会议平台，围绕光学时敏弱小目标探测中的关键问题，设置"红外视频卫星空中动目标检测"和"基于事件相机的运动小目标检测"两个赛道，为参赛队伍提供公平、可复现的算法验证平台，推动相关数据建设、方法创新和技术交流。
17555.description_zh:
Optical temporal-sensitive small target detection is an important research direction in intelligent visual perception and a key technical issue in target detection and situational awareness in complex environments. Compared with conventional target detection tasks, small targets typically exhibit characteristics such as small imaging scale, weak target energy, strong background interference, and unstable target morphology. The information available in a single frame is very limited, and algorithms are prone to missed detections, false positives, and discontinuous detection results in real-world scenarios.

This challenge competition, based on the CSIG2026 academic conference platform, focuses on key problems in optical temporal-sensitive small target detection, establishing two tracks: "infrared video satellite aerial moving target detection" and "event camera-based moving small target detection." It provides participating teams with a fair and reproducible algorithm validation platform, promoting related data construction, method innovation, and technical exchange.

pages.title: 赛事说明
pages.content:
## 挑战赛的目的 **通过本次挑战赛促进科研技术的交流研讨和应用推广** 本次挑战赛旨在依托 CSIG2026 学术会议平台，围绕光学时敏弱小目标探测中的关键问题，搭建面向学术界和产业界的开放竞赛与交流平台，吸引更多高校、科研院所和企业团队参与红外视频小目标检测、事件相机小目标检测等方向的研究。 **通过本次挑战赛促进光学时敏弱小目标探测技术发展** 通过竞赛汇聚工业界和学术界的智慧与力量，促进相关算法、数据集和评价体系的共同发展，推动领域垂类大模型发展与应用，加速技术创新和产业推广。 --- ## 挑战赛的意义 **光学时敏弱小目标探测应用广泛，关键技术问题突出** 光学时敏弱小目标探测是智能视觉感知领域中的重要研究方向，也是复杂环境下目标探测与态势感知中的关键技术问题。弱小目标通常存在成像尺度小、目标能量弱、背景干扰强、目标形态不稳定等特点，单帧图像中可利用的信息十分有限。 **红外视频卫星目标检测亟需融合时域信息与轨迹关联** 卫星视角下的红外视频弱小目标往往具有成像距离远、信噪比低、背景复杂、运动轨迹细弱等特点，仅依靠单帧检测难以获得稳定结果，需要进一步结合多帧时域信息、运动一致性和目标轨迹关联关系。 **事件相机小目标检测亟需发挥事件流时空连续性优势** 事件相机能够以异步方式感知亮度变化，具有高时间分辨率、低延迟、高动态范围和低数据冗余等优势。面向事件点云和事件流的时空建模方法发展，对于提升复杂场景下运动小目标的检测能力具有重要意义。 **公开数据和统一评测标准有助于推动领域发展** 红外视频卫星目标和事件相机小目标相关公开数据仍相对有限，真实场景数据获取和标注成本较高。本次竞赛通过开放具有针对性的数据资源和统一评测标准，为参赛队伍提供公平、可复现的算法验证平台。 --- ## 任务设置 ### 赛道一：红外视频卫星空中动目标检测 赛道一的主要任务是对视频中的红外小目标的质心进行预测，附加任务是对目标进行跟踪。参赛队伍根据红外小目标图像特点自行设计相关算法，使用主办方提供的数据集进行模型训练，最终以召回率（Recall）、精确率（Precision）和 F1 分数作为评价指标，以及轨迹完整度和轨迹准确度作为附加评价指标，衡量参赛队伍算法模型的性能。 ### 赛道二：基于事件相机的运动小目标检测 赛道二的主要任务是对事件流中的目标事件进行逐事件分割。参赛队伍根据事件小目标特性自行设计相关算法，使用主办方提供的事件数据集进行模型训练，最终以交并比（IoU）、准确率（ACC）、检测率（Pd）和虚警率（Fa）作为主要评价指标，衡量参赛队伍算法模型的性能。 --- ## 数据集简介 ### 赛道一数据集简介 竞赛数据集由国防科技大学与武汉大学联合开发，包括：基于热红外卫星的 IRAir 数据集、基于 Landsat 卫星的 IRSatVideo-LEO 数据集、基于高分四号卫星的 IRSatVideo-GEO 数据集，以及实测卫星热红外视频数据，共 1400 段视频序列（1000 段用于训练，200 段用于验证，200 段用于测试）。比赛开始前，将发布训练集和验证集视频及掩码标注；进入评测阶段时公布测试集视频，测试集标签不公开。 | 数据集 | 数据集简介 | 图像与目标示意 | | :---: | :---: | :---: | | IRAir | 数据来源：热红外 SDG 卫星一号图像，仿真目标
目标特点：飞机，低轨，暗目标
分辨率：256×256 | | | IRSatVideo-LEO | 数据来源：Landsat 卫星图像，仿真目标
目标特点：低轨，亮目标，短波红外
分辨率：1024×1024 | | | IRSatVideo-GEO | 数据来源：高分四号卫星图像，仿真目标
目标特点：地球同步轨道，中波红外，弱目标
分辨率：742×733（平均） | | | 实测热红外视频数据 | 数据来源：实测卫星热红外视频
目标特点：长波
分辨率：512×640 | | ### 赛道二数据集简介 基于 DAVIS346 事件相机的 EV-UAV 数据集作为训练、验证和测试数据集。总共 147 段序列（99 段用于训练，24 段用于验证，24 段用于测试）。（暂定） | 数据集 | 数据集简介 | 图像与目标示意 | | :---: | :---: | :---:| | EV-UAV  | 数据来源：DAVIS346 事件相机实拍
分辨率：346×260 | | --- ## 挑战赛评价方式 ### 赛道一评价方式 本次挑战赛赛道一的算法评价指标为召回率（Recall）和精确率（Precision），附加评价指标为轨迹完整度、轨迹准确度。算法最终评分结果由 F1 分数和附加分数组成。 $$ Recall = \frac{TD}{AT}, \quad Precision = \frac{TD}{TD + FD} $$ $$ F1 = \frac{2 \times Recall \times Precision}{Recall + Precision} $$ $$ TrackCompleteness = \frac{NTA}{N}, \quad TrackAccuracy = \frac{NTA}{NA} $$ | 附加得分项 | 阈值一 | 阈值二 | 阈值三 | | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | | 轨迹完整度得分 | ≥25%：+2分 | ≥35%：+3分 | ≥50%：+5分 | | 轨迹准确度得分 | ≥55%：+2分 | ≥65%：+3分 | ≥80%：+5分 | 最终得分为 F1 分数 × 100 + 附加得分，满分为 110 分。 --- ### 赛道二评价方式 赛道二的算法评价指标为交并比（IoU）、准确率（Acc）、检测率（Pd）和虚警率（Fa），最终评分结果由各指标加权得分。 $$ IoU = \frac{GT \cap Pred}{GT \cup Pred}, \quad Acc = \frac{TP_{target}}{TP_{target} + FN_{target}} $$ $$ Pd = \frac{TD}{AT}, \quad Fa = \frac{FD}{N_{frame} \times H \times W} $$ $$ Score_{Fa} = e^{-10000 \times Fa} $$ $$ Score = 0.4Pd + 0.3Score_{Fa} + 0.2IoU + 0.1Acc $$ --- ## 结果提交方式 **结果提交格式、提交入口和提交次数限制**：待补充 **提交内容与时间要求**：参赛队伍须在规定时间内提交测试结果，并在后继阶段提交算法代码、模型文件及算法报告。组委会将对各参赛队伍进行真实性审查。 **真实性与可复现性要求**：为避免参赛队伍滥用其他数据集或验证集标签信息用于算法训练，参赛队伍需提供算法训练时的相关参数，确保算法结果可复现。如发现违规使用数据信息或算法结果无法复现，组委会将按赛事规则处理。 --- ## 专题研讨会 组委会将举办挑战赛技术论坛，邀请获得一、二等奖的参赛队伍参加作特邀技术报告。 --- ## 知识产权归属 参赛队伍提交的算法及可执行模型的知识产权归参赛团队所有，比赛数据集归主办方所有。 各参赛队伍需要承诺提交的结果可重复，组织方承诺履行保密义务，并不用于除本挑战赛外的任何其他用途。 参赛队伍应保证所提供的方案、算法属于自有知识产权。组织方对参赛队伍因使用本队提供完成的算法和结果而产生的任何实际侵权或者被任何第三方指控侵权概不负责。一旦上述情况和事件发生，参赛队伍必须承担一切相关法律责任和经济赔偿责任并保护组织方免于承担该等责任。
